description: This file defines the MCUmgr management API, including data types, function prototypes, and structures for handling command groups and handlers in the mcumgr protocol.

methods.name: mgmt_find_handler
methods.description: Finds a registered command handler by group and command ID.

methods.name: mgmt_find_group
methods.description: Finds a registered command group by group ID.

methods.name: mgmt_get_handler
methods.description: Gets a command handler from a group by command ID.

methods.name: mgmt_find_error_translation_function
methods.description: Finds an error translation function for SMP error codes.
